node.title: HGE4 Kummer trace-power gcd compiler
node.statement: For dyadic m>=8 and q=(p-1)/m, the squarefree polynomial Q_m defined by C_m(X)-2=(X^2-4)Q_m(X)^2 has exactly the nontrivial mu_m trace values as roots. Taking M=m for even q and M=m/2 for odd q, the exact number of traces passing the Kummer power gate is the degree of gcd(Q_M, (-(X+2)/8)^q-1) over F_p. The exponent is evaluated modulo Q_M. Nonconstant exact controls show this is a candidate compiler, not an emptiness or orbit theorem.
